title: Impressed with handling, power, and tech
summary: Reviews in this topic are mainly expressions of being impressed by the car, especially its handling, power, tech kit, and overall driving feel, with a small number saying the opposite or regretting the purchase.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say owners are impressed with the car overall, especially its power, crisp handling, tech kit, and driving enjoyment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say some owners are not impressed, including one who explicitly regrets buying the car.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined example describes the crisp-looking kidney grille without enough context to tell whether it is praise or simple description.

limitations: Most examples are brief statements of being impressed or not impressed, so the specific reasons are limited in some reviews.
The undetermined fragment is a short design description, which limits confidence about its sentiment.
This is a sentiment-stratified sample of fragments and not a representative estimate of all reviews.
